summary: Checked all six estimates against the saved 19-page manuscript, read the complete markdown conversion including references, notes, figures, and the final table, and extracted the cited PDF pages with pymupdf. Confirmed Figure 1 treatment and control means of 4.53 and 3.802, the 0.41 SD effect and 95% CI [0.23, 0.59], and the separately recorded prose effect of 0.45 SD with p<0.001. The discrepancy between the prose and figure is in the manuscript and is explicitly preserved in the extraction. Confirmed the outcome and contrast coding, rating-level observations and participant-clustered uncertainty for Figure 1, and null statistics for the four separately named grade outcomes. Analysis-specific participant counts are not printed; recruitment and baseline descriptive counts cannot supply them. The main pooled linear/convex incentive analysis is explicitly identified as restricted to those schemes. The fixed-time incentive subgroup, moderation, process measures, self-reports, and model-only comparisons are documented exclusions. No additional in-scope outcome or contrast was found in the supplied manuscript. The separately referenced Supplementary Materials are not included in this PDF.
